market_outlook.short_term: Bond market remains the dominant risk. 30-year yield at 2004 high with Fed hike bets spiking creates headwinds for equities. Oil above $102 sustains inflation pressure. Expect volatility in rate-sensitive sectors. AI names may pull back on valuation concerns but infrastructure plays hold. Geopolitical headlines (Iran, Ukraine) create whipsaw in energy and defense.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains structurally bullish but requires earnings validation. Rising rate environment favors value, energy, and financials over growth. China trade uncertainty and geopolitical fragmentation support domestic manufacturing and defense. Education/fiscal stress in US may drive policy intervention. Gold and real assets gain structural support from inflation and geopolitical risk.
